original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳新爱国党全国主席选举：民调显示约翰·博阿杜等四人领先
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳新爱国党（NPP）即将举行全国主席选举，库马西技术大学Smart Sarpong教授与Feedback Africa合作开展的最新政治环境评估调查显示，前总书记约翰·博阿杜被视为最有可能胜选的候选人。JFK、Titus-Glover和Hawa Koomson同样在调查中领先。该调查为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 加纳新爱国党前总书记约翰·博阿杜在民调中被认为最有可能赢得该党全国主席选举
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Former General Secretary of the New Patriotic Party (NPP), John Boadu, has emerged as the candidate respondents consider most likely to win the party’s upcoming National Chairmanship election.

key_facts.fact: 该调查由库马西技术大学Smart Sarpong教授与Feedback Africa合作开展
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: This is according to the latest Political Environment Assessment Survey conducted by Prof. Smart Sarpong of the Kumasi Technical University in collaboration with Feedback Africa.

key_facts.fact: 报道称JFK、Titus-Glover和Hawa Koomson在调查中同样领先
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: NPP NEC election: John Boadu, JFK, Titus-Glover and Hawa Koomson in strong lead, according to latest national outlook survey

uncertainties: 该调查结果目前仅有一个来源（MyJoyOnline）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
民调结果不代表最终选举结果，选举尚未举行
